title: lye configuration
description: The lye.json a workspace or package reads: plugins, module search paths, and diagnostic policy.

plugins.description: Plugins read with this document, in order: a path of the workspace's own, an installed module name, or `!name` to turn off a plugin lye ships.

requirePaths.description: Search paths for `require`, written the way `package.path` does: `lib/?.lua`, `vendor/?/init.lua`.

diagnostics.description: The policy a diagnostic code is held to in this workspace.

severity.description: A diagnostic code's severity, or `off`/`none` to turn it off. `error`, `warning`, `hint`, and `information` name the LSP severities; 1, 2, and 3 are the same severities as numbers.

disable.description: Diagnostic codes this workspace turns off.
